about.title: Who are we?
about.intro: We are the American Chemical Society Student Chapter of the National University of San Marcos, dedicated to fostering interest in chemistry and science within the student community.
about.missionText: To awaken interest in science in young people, promoting participation in scientific and academic activities that enrich their education.
about.visionText: To become the leading student reference for scientific dissemination and professional development in the field of chemistry in Peru.

homePage.welcomePart1: Welcome to the ACS International Student Chapter UNMSM! We are excited to welcome you to our student chapter of the American Chemical Society at the National University of San Marcos. Here you will find information about our activities, projects, and opportunities to grow alongside a community passionate about chemistry. We believe in continuous learning and collaboration, which is why we are open to hearing your ideas, comments, and suggestions. If you want to be part of this space, contribute with initiatives, or simply learn more about us, contact us.
homePage.welcomePart2: Together we can promote chemistry and make a positive impact!
homePage.welcomePart3: We look forward to seeing you! 💙⚗️
homePage.portadaTexto: We are the student chapter of the American Chemical Society at the Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos, the oldest university in the Americas. We share science, do research and build community.

resources.title: Resources
resources.intro: An open library for the chapter: databases, calculation tools, journals and open calls. Everything we use, in one place.
resources.aviso: Section under construction. These links are a starting point; if you know of one that is missing, write to us.

pubchem.texto: The largest public molecule database: structures, properties and safety data. The starting point for almost any query.

acsPubs.texto: The American Chemical Society journal catalogue. As a student chapter we have access to part of the content.

rsc.texto: Journals, teaching material and outreach resources from the British chemical society.

chemdraw.texto: Editors for drawing molecules and reactions for reports and presentations. Free alternatives include MolView and Ketcher.

nist.texto: Peer-checked thermodynamic data and reference spectra. For when you need a reliable, citable value.

sds.texto: Before touching a reagent, read it. How to find and interpret a safety data sheet.

becas.texto: ACS programmes, student conferences and mobility grants open to undergraduate students.

ceviche.texto: How to cite, how to prepare a poster and how to present at chapter events. Internal document of the academic area.

news.title: News
news.intro: What is happening in the chapter: events, achievements by our members and open calls.

semanaQuimica.titulo: Chemistry Week returns to San Marcos
semanaQuimica.resumen: Five days of talks, workshops and demonstrations open to the whole university community. This year the focus is green chemistry and its role in Peruvian industry. The full programme will be published in the Events section.

divulgacionEscolar.titulo: Over 200 schoolchildren at our outreach day
divulgacionEscolar.resumen: The chapter brought experiments and teaching material to a school in Lima. Secondary students prepared their own posters on everyday reactions and presented them to the younger children.

congresoNacional.titulo: Two members present at the national chemistry congress
congresoNacional.resumen: Their work on soil remediation and water analysis was selected from more than a hundred abstracts. It is the first time the chapter presents at this edition of the congress.

convocatoriaMiembros.resumen: We are looking for students from any year interested in outreach, research or project management. No previous experience needed, just the willingness to take part.

laboratorioAbierto.titulo: Open lab: guided tour of the faculty laboratories
laboratorioAbierto.resumen: An afternoon to see inside the laboratories where the faculty research groups work, guided by the thesis students themselves.
